meta.name: Veri Mimarı Editorial Data System
meta.description: Veri Mimarı'nın sıcak kâğıt, güçlü editoryal tipografi, teknik meta etiketleri, sert konturlar ve flüoresan aksiyon renklerinden oluşan kanonik tasarım kimliği.

color.palette_type: high-contrast complementary accents on warm neutrals

typography.font_style_notes: Very tight negative display tracking; readable body copy; technical mono only for metadata.

spacing.section_rhythm: full-width alternating bands with 72-108px vertical padding

layout.grid_system: 1180px centered shell, two-column hero, three-column content grids
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with occasional rotated labels

elevation.shadow_style: hard drop with optional soft ambient layer
elevation.depth_cues: hard shadows, overlapping notes, bordered circular field

components.button_style: outlined pills; dark primary; lime hero CTA with hard shadow
components.brand_mark: compact ink VM monogram on a transparent surface with a restrained lime directional tail
components.input_style: white field, dark 1px border, lime focus halo
components.card_style: flat grid cells or 14px outlined panels with hard drop shadow
components.list_style: bordered grid cells with mono index
components.component_notes: Interactive calculators retain their behavior; only presentation changes.
components.data_table: Full-width outlined panel with lime filter pills, labeled fields, sortable accessible headers, per-metric history actions and daily records; mobile rows become labeled metric cards. Unknowns remain distinct from zero; history is bounded by report date.

social_media.grid: 12 conceptual columns, 8px spacing unit, optional 48px technical background grid
signature_elements: current transparent VM monogram with lime tail
social_media.content_rule: one promise, one dominant accent, one primary CTA
social_media.data_rule: source and date numerical claims; label examples as DEMO VERİ or SİMÜLASYON

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an annotated field guide crossed with a modern data console

visual_language.whitespace_usage: large section rhythm and roomy hero
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: oversized left copy balanced by a dense right console
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero message followed by progressive content bands
visual_language.texture_usage: fine grid, dashed rings, hard shadows

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: small up-left movement with a hard shadow

overview.fallback_strategy: flat warm background and static accents

background_effects.description: 48px technical grid with restrained lime and cyan radial glows

visual_effects.composite_notes: All decorative effects are CSS and preserve calculator accessibility and performance.
